name: Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University
about: Hajee Mohammad Danesh Science and Technology University is a public university in Dinajpur, Rangpur Division. It began in 1979 as an Agricultural Extension Training Institute, became Hajee Mohammad Danesh Agricultural College in 1988, and was upgraded to a university in 1999; its Act was passed in 2001. It has 9 faculties and 45 departments, with around 11,000 students.
